description: Lists the accounts the calling account follows, newest first. status="requested" lists the requests it has sent to private accounts and that are still pending. Following and un-following are done in the Jam Jam application, never by API.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's `nextCursor`. Replay it verbatim.

status.description: "accepted" (default) for established follows, "requested" for pending requests. Closed list: any other value is refused, the two states never mix.

name: jj_list_following
title: List the accounts I follow
